svg.text: Build flow — how Vortex RTL becomes a FireSim image

Left: the default FAME-1 build, where Vortex stays Verilog and Golden Gate never sees inside it. Right: FAME5=1, where Vortex is converted to FIRRTL so Golden Gate can thread the sockets. Both run from hw/syn/firesim/Makefile with the native flows' tokens.
Common front end — the configured tree, flattened
make -C hw/syn/firesim [PLATFORM=<xsa> | DEVICE=<part>] TARGET=hw|sim|hw_emu [FAME5=1] [PERF=1] CONFIGS="-DVX_CFG_…"
gen_sources.sh -P preprocesses hw/rtl into one self-contained directory (macros inlined), top VX_firesim_wrap:
vivado_srcs/ + .f ← -DSYNTHESIS -DVIVADO -DNDEBUG (+ -DSIMULATION for TARGET=sim/hw_emu, never under FAME5)
vortex_srcs/ (metasim) ← -DNDEBUG only: behavioural RAMs, soft FPU
Platform defines both lanes share: VX_CFG_PLATFORM_MEMORY_NUM_BANKS=1 · PLATFORM_MEMORY_ID_WIDTH=4 (paired with idBits) · [PERF_ENABLE]
Default: FAME-1, Vortex as a Verilog BlackBox
stage → replace-rtl — Golden Gate on the harness only
VortexTarget.scala elaborates: VortexDUT holds VX_firesim_wrap as an opaque BlackBox;
Golden Gate applies FAME-1 at its boundary, inserts bridges and token channels.
→ FireSim-generated.sv (harness; Vortex NOT inside)
xilinx-ips — vendor floating-point cores
xil_fma, xil_fdiv, … generated for FPGA_PART; the flattened tree only instantiates them.
(On aved the RTU keeps the soft FMA/divider: the clock-enable conversion cannot enter an OOC core.)
Platform build — the card's own flow
vitis: v++ link · aved: slashkit. The kernel is packaged from three inputs:
VORTEX_VIVADO_SRCS = the flattened tree VORTEX_XILINX_IP_DIR = the vendor cores
FireSim-generated.sv = the harness VORTEX_PRE_OPT_TCL = async-BRAM patch hook
Vivado synthesis + place-and-route at FREQUENCY (default 60 MHz), STRATEGY=TIMING;
on aved, FireSim's clock gates become clock enables (no BUFGCE in the partition).
Image — build32_<aved|xsa>_<hw|sim|hw_emu>/bin/
firesim.vbin | firesim.xclbin + firesim.card
Metasimulator (no image) — TARGET=xrtsim / avedsim
`elaborate` runs Golden Gate alone; sim/firesim/Makefile Verilates
FireSim-generated.sv + the vortex_srcs tree (library search) into libfiresim.so,
with simif_emul as the host interface — the design itself is the simulator.
EMUL_DEBUG=1 adds --trace +define+DEBUG → +waveformfile=… writes a VCD
FAME5=1 uses the generated RTL only (Vortex is already inside it)
Same target, same tokens as the card: the step before silicon.
FAME5=1: Vortex converted to FIRRTL, sockets threaded
sv2v — SystemVerilog → Verilog-2005
fame5/vortex.v (interfaces inlined; VX_socket_top keeps a plain-wire boundary)
to_firrtl.sh — Yosys → FIRRTL (fame5/)
Flattens everything except VX_socket_top (the threaded unit, instantiated without
parameters); VX_dp_ram / VX_sp_ram become black boxes that gen_rams.py regenerates
as FIRRTL memories (clocked reads, byte enables); fix_firrtl.py repairs what Yosys
emits that the FIRRTL compiler rejects (signed shifts, deep nesting, cat-LHS, …).
→ fame5/vortex.fir (~384 MB at 64 cores NW=NT=16, ~4 min)
splice + annotate + Golden Gate
splice.py replaces the harness FIR's VX_firesim_wrap extmodule with the converted Vortex;
annotate_threads.py adds one FirrtlEnableModelMultiThreadingAnnotation per socket
instance (FAME5_THREADS=0 skips: same design, unthreaded, must match cycle-for-cycle).
Golden Gate then applies FAME-1 + FAME-5: one threaded copy, N-deep state.
→ FireSim-generated.sv (Vortex inside; 229 MB at 64 cores, ~12 min / 36 GB heap)
Platform build — handed nothing but the generated RTL
No Vortex sources, no vendor IP, no pre-opt hook: nothing outside FireSim-generated.sv
is left for them to apply to. Same Vivado flow, FREQUENCY, STRATEGY.
Image — build32_aved_hw_fame5/bin/firesim.vbin
_fame5 directories throughout; VortexFame5Config keys the generated RTL apart
RTL preconditions (all under `ifdef VX_CFG_FAME5): CORE_ID parameter → core_id/socket_id
ports so all sockets elaborate identically; ASYNC_BRAM_PATCH off; no VM, no graphics.
Run either lane's image with the same command: FPGA_BIN_DIR=<bin> ./ci/blackbox.sh --driver=firesim --target=hw --app=… (FAME5=1 for a threaded build).
The Makefile guards the classic failure modes: SYNTHESIS missing from the flattened tree (every RAM lands in LUTRAM), VX_MEM_PORTS resolving to 0, a changed CONFIGS reusing a stale flatten.
